- **Translation & Policy Merging** ([consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lu_t6n81/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go), [constructor.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lu_t6n81/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go), [traffic_policy_plugin.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lu_t6n81/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go), [merge.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lu_t6n81/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go)):
  - Implemented [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lu_t6n81/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L188-L325) to build Envoy `RouteAction.HashPolicy` entries in canonical type order (`headers`, `cookies`, `queryParameters`, `filterState`, `sourceIp`), defaulting to a single `sourceIp` policy (`terminal: false`) when no sub-fields are specified, deduplicating array fields by key (case-insensitive for headers while preserving first-occurrence casing), rewriting header values via `regexRewrite`, and parsing cookie `ttl` as either Go duration strings or plain integer seconds.
  - Implemented [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lu_t6n81/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go#L625-L669) and [`unionConsistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lu_t6n81/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L356-L386) to suppress broader-scoped policies when `disable` is `true`, union array fields with higher-priority entries first, deduplicate by key, re-sort into canonical type order, retain the higher-priority `sourceIp` value even when unset, and record merge metadata under `consistentHash`.
- **Tests** ([consistent_hash_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-lu_t6n81/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash_test.go)):
  - Added unit tests covering IR construction, validation, canonical ordering, deduplication, cookie TTL formats, `disable` suppression, multi-policy merging, and route application.
